the-pamin.format: Black Signature: 500 mg dry component; Black Enhancer: 7 ml liquid component
about: THE PAMIN consists of freeze-dried Black Signature and liquid Black Enhancer. The Black Signature label specifies 500 mg of dry contents; Black Enhancer contains 7 ml of liquid. These are two different measurements, rather than the volume of one vial or the entire set.

Black Signature lists Human Adipocyte Conditioned Media Extract, Sodium DNA (PDRN), hydrolyzed collagen, SH-Oligopeptide-1, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 and Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7. Niacinamide, madecassoside, panthenol, Ceramide NP, glycerin and butylene glycol are also listed.

For Black Enhancer, the catalog lists bisabolol, bakuchiol, hyaluronic ingredients, tremella, sodium lactate, a nine-peptide complex, adenosine and Anemarrhena root extract. These are key ingredients taken from our separate descriptions; no concentrations in the final mixture are stated here.

Before application, pour all the Black Enhancer into Black Signature, attach the supplied cone-shaped cap and shake until evenly mixed. Apply after toner and before cream. Our instructions recommend refrigerating the mixed product and using it within a week where possible; this is a recommendation in the instructions, rather than a shelf life validated by testing.

REBELOOK combines two sequential steps: Gold Signature and Highlighter. Apply Gold Signature first, allow it to absorb, then finish with Highlighter. This program differs from mixing the components of THE PAMIN.

Gold Signature contains Abelmoschus manihot flower extract, a nine-peptide complex, PDRN, collagen and hyaluronic acid. Our catalog also lists four sources of exosome ingredients: milk, centella, ginseng and lactobacilli.

Highlighter lists Abelmoschus manihot extract, nine peptides, snail mucin, eight hyaluronic ingredients, centella and madecassoside. The catalog identifies the same four sources of exosome ingredients as for Gold Signature.

The program is intended for cosmetic care focused on radiance and the appearance of skin. Ingredient descriptions do not establish delivery to deeper skin layers or a therapeutic effect. LUMILOOK is presented separately; the materials do not confirm that it was renamed REBELOOK.

ready-booster.format: Foam toner with a pump, 200 ml
about: Repair Ready Toner De Rose Bubble Booster comes as a 200 ml foam toner with a pump. Rose water and a bubble texture define this first care step after cleansing.

The catalog lists niacinamide, adenosine, AQUA TECA 1000T, COOLIF, BIO Marine Summer, BIORAN EX Infla Care and CeraPlex 5. AQUA TECA combines centella, madecassoside, madecassic acid, asiaticoside and asiatic acid. CeraPlex 5 lists ceramides NP, EOP, NS, AS and AP.

The moisturizing group includes HYAL 11, hydroxyethyl urea, betaine, Saccharide Isomerate, panthenol and allantoin. HYAL 11 is a complex name, rather than independent confirmation of eleven different forms of hyaluronic acid. The formula also lists the Matrixyl 3000 peptide complex.

Botanical ingredients include Melia azadirachta flowers and leaves, Coccinia and eggplant fruits, turmeric root, aloe flowers, holy basil leaves and Corallina officinalis. According to the instructions, spread two to three pumps over the skin, press gently with the palms until absorbed, then move on to the next product.
72K FILM AMPOULE is a 50 ml home care product with a film-forming texture. The number 72K is part of the name and does not indicate how long the effect lasts or the gold content.

The catalog lists Abelmoschus manihot flower extract, lavender water, tranexamic acid, hibiscus, niacinamide and adenosine. CENTELLA QUATRO combines asiaticoside, madecassoside, madecassic acid and asiatic acid; dipotassium glycyrrhizate is also listed.

The moisturizing group includes sodium hyaluronate, hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid, betaine, tremella, panthenol, aloe leaf extract and allantoin. Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate is one of the peptides listed. The presence of an ingredient does not imply an effect comparable to a medical procedure.

Spread the product over the face after toner; the instructions allow an additional layer on dry areas. Our FAQ describes daily use, including before makeup. The toner and ampoule occupy different steps in a care routine; describing them together is not a report of testing the combination.

heads: Raw material research and the finished formula
paragraphs: In the REBELOOK and 72K sections, we describe the PSM approach to Abelmoschus manihot botanical raw material. For 72K, the relationship between the polysaccharide fraction and the film-forming texture is presented separately. This is our approach to the ingredient.

The catalog mentions solubilization and protein fraction processing in the preparation of botanical raw materials. These stages help explain how we approach formulation work; the material provides no basis for comparing penetration with competitors or claiming numerical superiority.

Some slides concern cell tests of individual ingredients. Such a test examines a raw material under specified conditions, rather than finished cosmetics in normal use. The result cannot automatically be attributed to REBELOOK, THE PAMIN, READY BOOSTER or 72K.

The before-and-after photographs in our catalog are our demonstrations. The supplied catalog does not include a full clinical report on the finished formulas with study design, sample details and methods. We therefore present ingredients, formats and instructions without numerical efficacy claims.
